validation.scope: Source/readback/model/V8 checks only. C++/Objective-C/AppKit compilation and native behavior remain unexecuted for this candidate.
validation.compilerMode: The C++ restoration catch is compiled only when Clang __has_feature(cxx_exceptions) is true; Objective-C handling and normal restoration remain unconditional. Actual generated target flags remain uninspected.

invariants: A maximum of four unique public native edges, with unchanged anchor rectangle and no close/reopen between candidates.
Actual post-layout full-frame containment remains required; coordinates-ready still gates reveal.
Initial-only hiding and opener capture; retained content/responder/composition are not recreated or explicitly reset.
Cache matches exact weak owner/positioning/content/popover, lifetime, nonempty scope/presentation tokens, parameters and preferred policy.
Independent invocation and generation guards abandon reentrant stale work before later native actions or reveal.
Only final failed containment closes/rejects once; current unavailable show/window preserves original non-rejection behavior.
Animation is restored in finally; newer props/recycle animation policy wins, and a cleanup exception cannot mask an original exception.
Last-show diagnostic is the actual last call, with bounded 1..4 attempt and closed edge enum; older calls cannot overwrite newer branch/show records.
Existing observers, dismissal/focus callbacks, public interfaces, driver/fixture actions and native acceptance predicates/deadlines remain unchanged.

primarySources.supports: Already-shown popovers accept updates to anchored view, rectangle and preferred edge without a required close/reopen.
Animation setting is a hint; no suppression/completion guarantee is assumed.
Shown state is not an animation-completion witness.
__has_feature(cxx_exceptions) reports whether C++ exceptions are enabled; the candidate supports either compiler mode without requiring a new flag.

limitations: No passing alternate native edge is inferred from synthetic geometry models.
No Objective-C exception, animation, run-loop or responder behavior is proved by V8 models.
The candidate retains the strict failed result unless actual native geometry/readiness meets the existing predicates.
No host, security, activation loop, observer removal or workflow changes are included.
The feature guard is compiler hygiene, not a correction of an observed compilation failure; no native compile result is available.
